headword: {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}
gloss: certified care worker; care welfare specialist

definitions.gloss: certified care worker; a nationally licensed professional who provides physical and daily-life assistance to the elderly and disabled
definitions.explanation: A nationally certified professional in Japan who provides hands-on physical care and daily living assistance to elderly and disabled individuals. The qualification is established by law and requires passing a national exam.

examples.japanese: {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained the certified care worker qualification.

examples.english: Certified care workers support the daily lives of the elderly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: In an aging society, the demand for certified care workers is growing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧ (nursing care), ⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧ (welfare), and ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (professional, specialist). This is a national qualification in Japan established by the {社会福祉士及|しゃかいふくししおよ}び{介護福祉士法|かいごふくししほう} (Social Worker and Care Worker Act). Holders provide hands-on care including bathing, eating, and mobility assistance.

- {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: certified care worker qualification
- {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: care worker certification exam
- {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a certified care worker

CULTURAL NOTE:
With Japan's rapidly aging population, {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし} is one of the most in-demand professional qualifications. Japan has also begun accepting foreign care workers under special visa programs to address labor shortages in this field.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{介護士|かいごし}→介護士：20025_kaigoshi⟧: care worker — informal term, not necessarily nationally certified
